# Helper: cluster-robust inference using sandwich + lmtest if available
has_sandwich <- requireNamespace("sandwich", quietly = TRUE)
has_lmtest   <- requireNamespace("lmtest", quietly = TRUE)

cr_test <- function(model, cluster) {
  if (has_sandwich && has_lmtest) {
    vc <- sandwich::vcovCL(model, cluster = cluster, type = "HC1")
    ct <- lmtest::coeftest(model, vcov. = vc)
    list(ct = ct, vc = vc, ok = TRUE)
  } else {
    warning("sandwich/lmtest not available: falling back to conventional (non-clustered) SE.")
    sm <- summary(model)
    # Build a coeftest-like matrix
    cm <- cbind(Estimate = sm$coefficients[,1],
                "Std. Error" = sm$coefficients[,2],
                "t value"    = sm$coefficients[,3],
                "Pr(>|t|)"   = sm$coefficients[,4])
    list(ct = cm, vc = vcov(model), ok = FALSE)
  }
}

print_ci <- function(beta, se, level = 0.95) {

  install.packages("fixest")

  install.packages("data.table")
}
library(fixest)
library(data.table)

# Define the file path
file_path <- "experiments/exp_b/data/s36_data.csv"

# Read the dataset
data <- fread(file_path)

# Ensure 'unit_id' and 'period' are treated as factors for fixed effects
data$unit_id <- as.factor(data$unit_id)
data$period <- as.factor(data$period)

# 1. Basic Difference-in-Differences Regression
# This model includes the raw DID terms but no fixed effects beyond the main 'treated' and 'post' terms
# which act as group and time dummies in the simplest form.
# The `treat_x_post` column is already provided, making this straightforward.
model_basic_did <- feols(y ~ treated + post + treat_x_post, data = data)

# 2. Difference-in-Differences Regression with Two-Way Fixed Effects (TWFE)
# This is the standard and more robust DID specification.
# It explicitly includes municipality-fixed effects (unit_id) and time-fixed effects (period).
# The `treat_x_post` coefficient will be the DID estimate.
model_twfe_did <- feols(y ~ treat_x_post | unit_id + period, data = data)

# 3. Robustness Check: TWFE with Clustered Standard Errors
# Clustered standard errors at the municipality level are crucial to account for
# potential autocorrelation within municipalities over time.
model_twfe_did_cluster <- feols(y ~ treat_x_post | unit_id + period, data = data, cluster = ~unit_id)

# Print summary for all models
cat("--- Basic DID Model (without explicit FE) ---\n")
print(summary(model_basic_did))
cat("\n--- DID Model with Two-Way Fixed Effects (TWFE) ---\n")
print(summary(model_twfe_did))
cat("\n--- DID Model with Two-Way Fixed Effects (TWFE) and Clustered Standard Errors ---\n")
print(summary(model_twfe_did_cluster))

# Extract and print the main causal effect (coefficient of treat_x_post)
cat("\n--- Main Causal Effect (Coefficient of treat_x_post) ---\n")
cat("Basic DID: ", coef(model_basic_did)["treat_x_post"], "\n")
cat("TWFE DID: ", coef(model_twfe_did)["treat_x_post"], "\n")
cat("TWFE DID (Clustered SE): ", coef(model_twfe_did_cluster)["treat_x_post"], "\n")

# Complete, self-contained R code

# 1) Setup --------------------------------------------------------------------
# Read data
data_path <- "experiments/exp_b/data/s44_data.csv"
dt <- read.csv(data_path, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# Basic checks
stopifnot(all(c("unit_id","period","treated","post","treat_x_post","y") %in% names(dt)))
dt$unit_id <- as.factor(dt$unit_id)
dt$period  <- as.integer(dt$period)
dt$treated <- as.integer(dt$treated)
dt$post    <- as.integer(dt$post)
dt$treat_x_post <- as.integer(dt$treat_x_post)
dt$y <- as.numeric(dt$y)

# Helper: cluster-robust vcov (fallback to classical if sandwich/lmtest unavailable)
get_vcov_cluster <- function(model, cluster_vec) {
  if (requireNamespace("sandwich", quietly = TRUE)) {
    return(sandwich::vcovCL(model, cluster = cluster_vec, type = "HC1"))
  } else {
    warning("Package 'sandwich' not available. Using classical (non-robust) variance.")
    return(stats::vcov(model))
  }
}

# Helper: extract estimate table for a named coefficient
extract_coef <- function(model, coef_name, vcov_mat) {
  beta <- coef(model)[coef_name]
  se <- sqrt(vcov_mat[coef_name, coef_name])
  tval <- beta / se
  # Normal approximation for p-value (matches coeftest default with sandwich vcov)
  pval <- 2 * pnorm(abs(tval), lower.tail = FALSE)
  ci_low <- beta - 1.96 * se
  ci_high <- beta + 1.96 * se
  list(beta = beta, se = se, t = tval, p = pval, ci_low = ci_low, ci_high = ci_high)
}

cat("Data summary:\n")
cat(sprintf("- N obs: %d | N units: %d | Years: %d to %d\n\n",
            nrow(dt), length(unique(dt$unit_id)), min(dt$period), max(dt$period)))

# 2) Main DID specifications ---------------------------------------------------
# (A) Simple DID without FE (baseline illustration)
m_simple <- lm(y ~ treat_x_post, data = dt)
V_simple <- get_vcov_cluster(m_simple, cluster_vec = dt$unit_id)
res_simple <- extract_coef(m_simple, "treat_x_post", V_simple)

# (B) Two-way fixed effects DID (unit and year FE)
# Use treat_x_post explicitly to avoid coefficient naming ambiguity
m_twfe <- lm(y ~ treat_x_post + factor(unit_id) + factor(period), data = dt)
V_twfe <- get_vcov_cluster(m_twfe, cluster_vec = dt$unit_id)
res_twfe <- extract_coef(m_twfe, "treat_x_post", V_twfe)

# Print main results
cat("Main DID results (log trade as outcome):\n")
cat(sprintf("Simple DID: beta = %.4f, se = %.4f, p = %.4f, 95%% CI [%.4f, %.4f]\n",
            res_simple$beta, res_simple$se, res_simple$p, res_simple$ci_low, res_simple$ci_high))
cat(sprintf("TWFE (unit & year FE): beta = %.4f, se = %.4f, p = %.4f, 95%% CI [%.4f, %.4f]\n",
            res_twfe$beta, res_twfe$se, res_twfe$p, res_twfe$ci_low, res_twfe$ci_high))
cat(sprintf("Implied percent change (TWFE): %.2f%%\n\n", 100*(exp(res_twfe$beta)-1)))

# 3) Robustness checks ---------------------------------------------------------
# (R1) Pre-trend test: pre-period only, test group-specific linear trend
pre <- subset(dt, post == 0)
if (nrow(pre) >= 10 && length(unique(pre$period)) >= 2) {
  pre$t_center <- pre$period - mean(pre$period)
  m_pretrend <- lm(y ~ factor(unit_id) + factor(period) + I(t_center * treated), data = pre)
  V_pretrend <- get_vcov_cluster(m_pretrend, cluster_vec = pre$unit_id)
  # Coefficient name is "I(t_center * treated)"
  coef_name_pretrend <- "I(t_center * treated)"
  if (coef_name_pretrend %in% names(coef(m_pretrend))) {
    res_pretrend <- extract_coef(m_pretrend, coef_name_pretrend, V_pretrend)
    cat("Pre-trend test (pre-period only, treated-specific linear trend):\n")
    cat(sprintf("beta_trend = %.5f, se = %.5f, p = %.4f, 95%% CI [%.5f, %.5f]\n\n",
                res_pretrend$beta, res_pretrend$se, res_pretrend$p,
                res_pretrend$ci_low, res_pretrend$ci_high))
  } else {
    cat("Pre-trend test: coefficient not identified (potential collinearity).\n\n")
  }
} else {
  cat("Pre-trend test skipped: insufficient pre-period variation.\n\n")
}

# (R2) Placebo DID in pre-period: fake policy date at median pre year
if (nrow(pre) >= 10 && length(unique(pre$period)) >= 3) {
  uniq_pre_years <- sort(unique(pre$period))
  fake_cut <- as.integer(stats::median(uniq_pre_years))
  pre$fake_post <- as.integer(pre$period >= fake_cut)
  # Ensure variation in fake_post
  if (length(unique(pre$fake_post)) == 2) {
    pre$fake_tx_post <- pre$treated * pre$fake_post
    m_placebo <- lm(y ~ fake_tx_post + factor(unit_id) + factor(period), data = pre)
    V_placebo <- get_vcov_cluster(m_placebo, cluster_vec = pre$unit_id)
    res_placebo <- extract_coef(m_placebo, "fake_tx_post", V_placebo)
    cat("Placebo DID (pre-period only, fake policy at median pre year):\n")
    cat(sprintf("beta_placebo = %.4f, se = %.4f, p = %.4f, 95%% CI [%.4f, %.4f]\n\n",
                res_placebo$beta, res_placebo$se, res_placebo$p,
                res_placebo$ci_low, res_placebo$ci_high))
  } else {
    cat("Placebo DID skipped: no variation in fake_post within pre-period.\n\n")
  }
} else {
  cat("Placebo DID skipped: insufficient pre-period years.\n\n")
}

# (R3) Sensitivity: add group-specific linear trend in full sample
dt$t_center_full <- dt$period - mean(dt$period)
dt$treated_trend <- dt$treated * dt$t_center_full
m_twfe_trend <- lm(y ~ treat_x_post + treated_trend + factor(unit_id) + factor(period), data = dt)
V_twfe_trend <- get_vcov_cluster(m_twfe_trend, cluster_vec = dt$unit_id)
res_twfe_trend <- extract_coef(m_twfe_trend, "treat_x_post", V_twfe_trend)
cat("TWFE + treated-specific linear trend (sensitivity):\n")
cat(sprintf("beta = %.4f, se = %.4f, p = %.4f, 95%% CI [%.4f, %.4f], implied %%: %.2f%%\n",
            res_twfe_trend$beta, res_twfe_trend$se, res_twfe_trend$p,
            res_twfe_trend$ci_low, res_twfe_trend$ci_high,
            100*(exp(res_twfe_trend$beta)-1)))

library(sandwich)
library(lmtest)

# 1) Read data
df <- read.csv("experiments/exp_b/data/s50_data.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# Basic sanity checks and coercions
df$treated <- as.integer(df$treated)
df$post    <- as.integer(df$post)
df$period  <- as.integer(df$period)
# Keep a numeric cluster id; also keep a factor for FE if panel
df$unit_id_num <- as.integer(df$unit_id)
df$unit_id_fac <- as.factor(df$unit_id)

# Detect whether we have a panel (same unit_id appearing in multiple periods)
panel_by_unit <- any(duplicated(df$unit_id_num))

cat("Unique units:", length(unique(df$unit_id_num)), "\n")
cat("Unique periods:", length(unique(df$period)), "\n")
cat("Panel structure (repeated unit_ids):", panel_by_unit, "\n\n")

# 2) Main DID specification
# If panel: include unit and period FE; key regressor is treated:post
# If repeated cross-sections: standard DID with treated + post + interaction
if (panel_by_unit) {
  formula_main <- y ~ treated:post + factor(unit_id_num) + factor(period)
} else {

                est_fd, se_fd, ci_fd_lo, ci_fd_hi, p_fd))

  }

calculate_abnormal_returns <- function(firm_data) {
  # Get estimation window data
  est_data <- firm_data[firm_data$event_day >= estimation_window[1] & 
                       firm_data$event_day <= estimation_window[2], ]
  
  # Estimate market model: R_it = alpha + beta * R_mt + epsilon_it
  # Note: beta is provided, so we estimate alpha
  market_model <- lm(ret ~ mkt_ret, data = est_data)
  alpha_hat <- coef(market_model)[1]
  beta_hat <- coef(market_model)[2]
  
  # Calculate abnormal returns for all days
  firm_data$abnormal_ret <- firm_data$ret - (alpha_hat + beta_hat * firm_data$mkt_ret)
  
  return(firm_data)
}

  group_by(stock_id) %>%
  do(calculate_abnormal_returns(.)) %>%
  ungroup()

                     results$event_day <= event_window[2], ]

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(tidyverse)
  library(fixest)      # for DiD robustness
})

# 1. Read data ---------------------------------------------------------
df <- read_csv("experiments/exp_b/data/s62_data.csv",
               col_types = cols(
                 stock_id = col_integer(),
                 event_day = col_integer(),
                 ret = col_double(),
                 mkt_ret = col_double(),
                 beta = col_double()
               ))

# 2. Identify the recalling firm --------------------------------------
# In the synthetic data the recalling company is stock_id == 0
recall_id <- 0     

# 3. Abnormal returns (market model) ----------------------------------
df <- df %>% 
  mutate(ar = ret - beta * mkt_ret)

# 4. Event-study results ----------------------------------------------
event_win  <- -1:1              # main window  (-1,0,+1)
rob_win    <- -3:3              # robustness window

# helper to compute CAR and its t-stat
car_stats <- function(data, win){
  ew <- data %>% filter(event_day %in% win)
  car  <- sum(ew$ar)
  
  # Use pre-event (-10 to ‑2) abnormal-return variance as estimator of σ
  pre <- data %>% filter(event_day %in% -10:-2)
  sigma_hat <- sd(pre$ar)
  t_stat <- car / (sigma_hat * sqrt(length(win)))
  tibble(CAR = car, t = t_stat, n = length(win))
}

car_main <- df %>% filter(stock_id == recall_id) %>% car_stats(event_win)
car_rob  <- df %>% filter(stock_id == recall_id) %>% car_stats(rob_win)

# 5. DiD robustness regression ----------------------------------------
df <- df %>% 
  mutate(post  = as.integer(event_day >= 0),
         treat = as.integer(stock_id == recall_id))

did_mod <- feols(ret ~ treat*post | stock_id + event_day,
                 data = df, cluster = "stock_id")

# 6. Output ------------------------------------------------------------
cat("=== Event-study: Recall firm (id =", recall_id, ") ===\n")
print(car_main, digits = 4)
cat("\nRobustness window (-3:+3):\n")
print(car_rob, digits = 4)

cat("\n=== Difference-in-Differences Robustness ===\n")
print(etable(did_mod, se = "cluster"), digits = 4)

  mutate(ar = ret - (beta * mkt_ret))

# Define event window and estimation window

estimation_window <- -20:-6  # Pre-event window for estimation of normal performance

# Function to calculate CAR over the event window for each stock
calculate_car <- function(data, stock_id, event_window) {
  stock_data <- data %>% filter(stock_id == stock_id)
  
  # Calculate abnormal return for each day in the event window
  ar_window <- stock_data %>% filter(event_day %in% event_window) %>% pull(ar)
  
  # Calculate CAR
  CAR <- sum(ar_window, na.rm = TRUE)
  return(CAR)
}

# Print results

pre_event_check <- data %>%
  filter(event_day %in% estimation_window) %>%
  summarize(pre_event_AR_mean = mean(ar, na.rm = TRUE))

# Load and analyze: Event Study for CAR around emissions standard announcement
# Data file path: experiments/exp_b/data/s65_data.csv

# 1) Read data
df <- read.csv("experiments/exp_b/data/s65_data.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# Basic checks
if(!all(c("stock_id","event_day","ret","mkt_ret","beta") %in% names(df))){
  stop("Required columns are missing from the input file.")
}
df$event_day <- as.integer(df$event_day)

# 2) Define windows
# Estimation window: all available pre-event days up to -6 (avoid near-event contamination)
est_win <- df$event_day <= -6
# If too few observations, fallback to all negatives
if(sum(est_win) < 10 && any(df$event_day < 0)) {
  est_win <- df$event_day < 0
}

# Event windows to evaluate
main_window <- c(-1, 1)  # Primary: [-1, +1]
alt_window1 <- c(0, 1)   # Alternative: [0, +1]
alt_window2 <- c(0, 0)   # Announcement day only
placebo_window <- c(-10, -6) # Placebo pre-event

# Helper to compute CAR stats given alpha, beta, and a sigma from estimation window
car_stats <- function(data, alpha, beta, sigma_e, window, est_df) {
  wdat <- subset(data, event_day >= window[1] & event_day <= window[2])
  k <- nrow(wdat)
  if(k == 0) {
    return(list(CAR=NA, t=NA, p=NA, k=0))
  }
  AR <- wdat$ret - (alpha + beta * wdat$mkt_ret)
  CAR <- sum(AR, na.rm = TRUE)
  # t-stat with variance k * sigma_e^2; use df from estimation (n_est - params)
  t_stat <- if(is.finite(sigma_e) && sigma_e > 0) CAR / (sqrt(k) * sigma_e) else NA
  # Two-sided p-value using t-dist with est_df degrees of freedom
  p_val <- if(is.finite(t_stat)) 2 * pt(-abs(t_stat), df = est_df) else NA
  list(CAR=CAR, t=t_stat, p=p_val, k=k)
}

# 3) Estimate models on the estimation window
est <- subset(df, est_win)
n_est <- nrow(est)
if(n_est < 5) stop("Insufficient pre-event observations for estimation.")

# (A) Market model: estimate alpha and beta via OLS on pre-event window
mm_fit <- lm(ret ~ mkt_ret, data = est)
alpha_hat <- coef(mm_fit)[1]
beta_hat  <- coef(mm_fit)[2]
sigma_hat <- sqrt(sum(residuals(mm_fit)^2) / (n_est - 2))  # residual std (df-adjusted)

# (B) Market-adjusted model (MAM): alpha=0, beta=1; sigma from pre-event residuals
mam_resid <- est$ret - est$mkt_ret
sigma_mam <- sd(mam_resid)
alpha_mam <- 0
beta_mam  <- 1
df_mam <- n_est - 1  # effectively estimating only variance

# (C) Provided-beta model: use given beta, estimate alpha with fixed beta on pre-window
if(length(unique(df$beta)) == 1) {
  beta_prov <- unique(df$beta)[1]
} else {
  # If beta varies (unexpected), take average in estimation window
  beta_prov <- mean(est$beta, na.rm = TRUE)
}
alpha_fixb <- mean(est$ret - beta_prov * est$mkt_ret, na.rm = TRUE)
fixb_resid <- est$ret - (alpha_fixb + beta_prov * est$mkt_ret)
sigma_fixb <- sd(fixb_resid)
df_fixb <- n_est - 1  # alpha estimated given fixed beta

# 4) Compute CARs and t-stats for each model and window
# Main model (market model)
main_car  <- car_stats(df, alpha_hat, beta_hat, sigma_hat, main_window, est_df = n_est - 2)
alt1_car  <- car_stats(df, alpha_hat, beta_hat, sigma_hat, alt_window1, est_df = n_est - 2)
alt2_car  <- car_stats(df, alpha_hat, beta_hat, sigma_hat, alt_window2, est_df = n_est - 2)
plac_car  <- car_stats(df, alpha_hat, beta_hat, sigma_hat, placebo_window, est_df = n_est - 2)

# Robustness: market-adjusted
main_car_mam <- car_stats(df, alpha_mam, beta_mam, sigma_mam, main_window, est_df = df_mam)
alt1_car_mam <- car_stats(df, alpha_mam, beta_mam, sigma_mam, alt_window1, est_df = df_mam)

# Robustness: provided-beta
main_car_fixb <- car_stats(df, alpha_fixb, beta_prov, sigma_fixb, main_window, est_df = df_fixb)
alt1_car_fixb <- car_stats(df, alpha_fixb, beta_prov, sigma_fixb, alt_window1, est_df = df_fixb)

# 5) Print results
cat("Event Study: Impact of Emissions Standard Announcement on CAR stock\n")
cat("Estimation window: event_day <=", max(est$event_day), "with", n_est, "observations\n")
cat(sprintf("Market model estimates: alpha = %.6f, beta = %.4f, sigma(eps) = %.6f\n",
            alpha_hat, beta_hat, sigma_hat))
cat("\nMain result (Market Model):\n")
cat(sprintf("  CAR[-1,+1] = %.4f (k=%d), t = %.2f, p = %.4f\n",
            main_car$CAR, main_car$k, main_car$t, main_car$p))
cat(sprintf("  CAR[0,+1]  = %.4f (k=%d), t = %.2f, p = %.4f\n",
            alt1_car$CAR, alt1_car$k, alt1_car$t, alt1_car$p))
cat(sprintf("  AR[0]      = %.4f (k=%d), t = %.2f, p = %.4f\n",
            alt2_car$CAR, alt2_car$k, alt2_car$t, alt2_car$p))

cat("\nPlacebo (pre-event) check under Market Model:\n")
cat(sprintf("  CAR[-10,-6] = %.4f (k=%d), t = %.2f, p = %.4f\n",
            plac_car$CAR, plac_car$k, plac_car$t, plac_car$p))

cat("\nRobustness: Market-Adjusted (alpha=0, beta=1)\n")
cat(sprintf("  CAR[-1,+1] = %.4f (k=%d), t = %.2f, p = %.4f\n",
            main_car_mam$CAR, main_car_mam$k, main_car_mam$t, main_car_mam$p))
cat(sprintf("  CAR[0,+1]  = %.4f (k=%d), t = %.2f, p = %.4f\n",
            alt1_car_mam$CAR, alt1_car_mam$k, alt1_car_mam$t, alt1_car_mam$p))

cat("\nRobustness: Provided-Beta Model (beta from data)\n")
cat(sprintf("  Provided beta = %.4f; estimated alpha = %.6f; sigma(eps) = %.6f\n",
            beta_prov, alpha_fixb, sigma_fixb))
cat(sprintf("  CAR[-1,+1] = %.4f (k=%d), t = %.2f, p = %.4f\n",
            main_car_fixb$CAR, main_car_fixb$k, main_car_fixb$t, main_car_fixb$p))
cat(sprintf("  CAR[0,+1]  = %.4f (k=%d), t = %.2f, p = %.4f\n",
            alt1_car_fixb$CAR, alt1_car_fixb$k, alt1_car_fixb$t, alt1_car_fixb$p))

# 6) Simple interpretation prompt
cat("\nInterpretation guide:\n")
cat("  Positive and significant CAR indicates the announcement increased CAR's value.\n")
cat("  Negative and significant CAR indicates value destruction.\n")

library(AER)      # For ivreg function
library(lmtest)   # For coeftest
library(sandwich) # For robust standard errors

# Define the data file path
data_path <- "experiments/exp_b/data/s22_data.csv"

# Read the data
data <- read.csv(data_path)

# Ensure column names are clean and match the description
names(data) <- c("y", "x", "z", "controls")

# --- OLS Regression (for comparison) ---
# This is a standard OLS regression without accounting for endogeneity
ols_model <- lm(y ~ x + controls, data = data)
cat("--- OLS Regression Results (for comparison) ---\n")
print(summary(ols_model))
cat("\n\n")

# --- First-Stage Regression ---
# This checks the relevance assumption: Instrument (z) correlation with endogenous variable (x)
first_stage_model <- lm(x ~ z + controls, data = data)
cat("--- First-Stage Regression Results (x ~ z + controls) ---\n")
print(summary(first_stage_model))
cat(sprintf("First-Stage F-statistic for 'z': %.2f (df1=%d, df2=%d)\n\n", 
            summary(first_stage_model)$fstatistic[1], 
            summary(first_stage_model)$fstatistic[2], 
            summary(first_stage_model)$fstatistic[3]))

# --- Second-Stage (IV) Regression ---
# Using the ivreg function from the AER package
# Syntax: dependent_var ~ exogenous_vars + endogenous_vars | exogenous_vars + instruments
# Here, 'x' is endogenous, 'z' is the instrument for 'x', and 'controls' is exogenous.
iv_model <- ivreg(y ~ x + controls | z + controls, data = data)

cat("--- IV Regression Results (y ~ x + controls | z + controls) ---\n")
print(summary(iv_model, vcov = vcovHC(iv_model, type = "HC1"))) # Robust standard errors

# Extract the coefficient for the endogenous variable 'x'
iv_coef_x <- coef(iv_model)["x"]
iv_se_x <- sqrt(diag(vcovHC(iv_model, type = "HC1")))["x"] # Robust SE for 'x'

cat(sprintf("\nIV Estimate for log employment growth (x) on log wage change (y): %.4f (Robust SE: %.4f)\n", 
            iv_coef_x, iv_se_x))

# A common pattern is that OLS might be biased due to endogeneity.
# If the endogeneity bias is positive (e.g., higher wages attract employment, or unobserved factors boost both),
# the OLS coefficient might be upward biased compared to the IV estimate.
# If the endogeneity bias is negative (e.g., productivity improvements reduce labor needs but boost wages),

############################################
# Impact of compulsory schooling on wages  #
############################################
# Load packages
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(readr)      # fast data import
  library(AER)        # ivreg
  library(sandwich)   # robust vcov
  library(lmtest)     # coeftest
  library(dplyr)      # data manipulation
})

# 1. Read the data
dat <- read_csv("experiments/exp_b/data/s68_data.csv",
                col_types = cols())

# Simple sanity check
print(head(dat, 3))

# 2. OLS benchmark (possibly biased)
ols <- lm(y ~ x + controls, data = dat)
cat("\n--- OLS estimate ---\n")
print(coeftest(ols, vcov = vcovHC(ols, type = "HC1")))

# 3. IV estimation (2SLS)
iv <- ivreg(y ~ x + controls | z + controls, data = dat)
cat("\n--- IV estimate (2SLS) ---\n")
print(coeftest(iv, vcov = vcovHC(iv, type = "HC1")))

# 4. First-stage relevance check
first_stage <- lm(x ~ z + controls, data = dat)
cat("\nFirst-stage F-statistic on instrument (z):\n")
fs_test <- waldtest(first_stage, . ~ controls, vcov = vcovHC(first_stage, type = "HC1"))
print(fs_test)

# 5. Weak-instrument diagnostics (Cragg-Donald / Stock-Yogo)
cat("\nDiagnostics from summary(iv, diagnostics = TRUE):\n")
print(summary(iv, diagnostics = TRUE))

# 6. Reduced-form (effect of z directly on y)
rf <- lm(y ~ z + controls, data = dat)
cat("\nReduced-form (effect of z on y) ---\n")
print(coeftest(rf, vcov = vcovHC(rf, type = "HC1")))

# 7. Robustness: specification without controls
iv_nocontrol <- ivreg(y ~ x | z, data = dat)
cat("\nIV without controls ---\n")
print(coeftest(iv_nocontrol, vcov = vcovHC(iv_nocontrol, type = "HC1")))

# 8. Report core causal estimate cleanly
beta_iv <- coef(iv)["x"]
ci_iv   <- confint(iv, vcov = vcovHC(iv, type = "HC1"))["x", ]
cat("\n==============================\n")
cat(sprintf("Causal effect of one extra year of schooling on log-wage (IV): %.4f\n", beta_iv))
cat(sprintf("Robust 95%% CI: [%.4f, %.4f]\n", ci_iv[1], ci_iv[2]))
cat("==============================\n")

# Load required packages
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(AER)
  library(sandwich)
  library(lmtest)
})

# Read data
dat <- read.csv("experiments/exp_b/data/s68_data.csv")
dat <- na.omit(dat)

# Basic sanity checks
stopifnot(all(c("y","x","z","controls") %in% names(dat)))
dat$z <- as.numeric(dat$z)  # ensure numeric 0/1

# Helper to print neatly
fmt <- function(x, d=4) formatC(x, format="f", digits=d)
print_result <- function(name, beta, se){
  ci <- beta + c(-1,1)*1.96*se
  pval <- 2*pnorm(abs(beta/se), lower.tail = FALSE)
  cat(paste0(name, ": beta = ", fmt(beta),
             ", SE = ", fmt(se),
             ", 95% CI [", fmt(ci[1]), ", ", fmt(ci[2]), "]",
             ", p = ", fmt(pval, d=4), "\n"))
}

cat("Sample size (after NA removal):", nrow(dat), "\n\n")

# 1) Naive OLS (for comparison)
ols <- lm(y ~ x + controls, data = dat)
ols_se_rob <- sqrt(diag(vcovHC(ols, type = "HC1")))
cat("OLS (y ~ x + controls)\n")
print_result("  Coef on x (OLS, robust SE)", coef(ols)["x"], ols_se_rob["x"])
cat("\n")

# 2) First stage: x on instrument and controls
fs <- lm(x ~ z + controls, data = dat)
fs_rob <- coeftest(fs, vcov = vcovHC(fs, type = "HC1"))
beta_z_fs <- coef(fs)["z"]
t_z_fs_rob <- fs_rob["z","t value"]
F_z_fs_rob <- as.numeric(t_z_fs_rob^2)
cat("First stage (x ~ z + controls)\n")
cat("  Coef on z =", fmt(beta_z_fs), "\n")
cat("  Robust t(z) =", fmt(t_z_fs_rob), "  => Robust F (weak-IV check) =", fmt(F_z_fs_rob), "\n\n")

# 3) 2SLS IV: y ~ x + controls | instruments = z + controls
iv <- ivreg(y ~ x + controls | controls + z, data = dat)
iv_vcov_hc <- vcovHC(iv, type = "HC1")
iv_ct <- coeftest(iv, vcov = iv_vcov_hc)
beta_iv <- coef(iv)["x"]
se_iv <- sqrt(diag(iv_vcov_hc))["x"]

cat("Main IV (2SLS): y ~ x + controls  |  instruments: z + controls\n")
print_result("  Coef on x (2SLS, robust SE)", beta_iv, se_iv)
cat("\n")

# 4) Reduced form and Wald ratio (consistency check)
rf <- lm(y ~ z + controls, data = dat)
rf_se_rob <- sqrt(diag(vcovHC(rf, type = "HC1")))
beta_rf <- coef(rf)["z"]
cat("Reduced form (y ~ z + controls)\n")
print_result("  Coef on z (RF, robust SE)", beta_rf, rf_se_rob["z"])
wald_ratio <- beta_rf / beta_z_fs
cat("  Wald ratio (RF / First-stage z->x) =", fmt(wald_ratio), "\n\n")

# 5) Robustness checks

# 5a) IV without controls
iv_noc <- ivreg(y ~ x | z, data = dat)
iv_noc_vcov_hc <- vcovHC(iv_noc, type = "HC1")
beta_iv_noc <- coef(iv_noc)["x"]; se_iv_noc <- sqrt(diag(iv_noc_vcov_hc))["x"]

cat("Robustness 1: IV without controls  (y ~ x | z)\n")
print_result("  Coef on x (2SLS, robust SE)", beta_iv_noc, se_iv_noc)
cat("\n")

# 5b) IV with nonlinear control (quadratic)
dat$controls2 <- dat$controls^2
iv_poly <- ivreg(y ~ x + controls + controls2 | z + controls + controls2, data = dat)
iv_poly_vcov_hc <- vcovHC(iv_poly, type = "HC1")
beta_iv_poly <- coef(iv_poly)["x"]; se_iv_poly <- sqrt(diag(iv_poly_vcov_hc))["x"]

cat("Robustness 2: IV with quadratic control  (y ~ x + controls + controls2 | z + controls + controls2)\n")
print_result("  Coef on x (2SLS, robust SE)", beta_iv_poly, se_iv_poly)
cat("\n")

# 5c) Report classic weak-IV diagnostics (AER)
diag_out <- capture.output(summary(iv, diagnostics = TRUE))
cat("Additional diagnostics (AER summary with classic tests):\n")
cat(paste0("  ", diag_out[grepl("Weak instruments|Wu-Hausman|Sargan", diag_out)], collapse = "\n"), "\n")

# Load packages (install if missing)
pkgs <- c("AER", "sandwich", "lmtest")
to_install <- pkgs[!pkgs %in% installed.packages()[,"Package"]]
if(length(to_install) > 0){
  install.packages(to_install, repos = "https://cloud.r-project.org")
}
library(AER)
library(sandwich)
library(lmtest)

# 1) Read data
df <- read.csv("experiments/exp_b/data/s84_data.csv")
df <- na.omit(df)

# Identify controls (all non y,x,z columns)
all_vars <- colnames(df)
controls <- setdiff(all_vars, c("y","x","z"))
has_controls <- length(controls) > 0

# Build formulas
form_ols <- as.formula(
  if (has_controls) paste("y ~ x +", paste(controls, collapse = " + ")) else "y ~ x"
)
form_fs <- as.formula(
  if (has_controls) paste("x ~ z +", paste(controls, collapse = " + ")) else "x ~ z"
)
form_rf <- as.formula(
  if (has_controls) paste("y ~ z +", paste(controls, collapse = " + ")) else "y ~ z"
)
form_iv <- as.formula(
  if (has_controls) paste("y ~ x +", paste(controls, collapse = " + "),
                          "| z +", paste(controls, collapse = " + "))
  else "y ~ x | z"
)

# 2) Baseline OLS (for comparison, not causal if x endogenous)
ols <- lm(form_ols, data = df)
ols_ct <- coeftest(ols, vcov. = vcovHC(ols, type = "HC1"))
beta_ols <- ols_ct["x","Estimate"]
se_ols   <- ols_ct["x","Std. Error"]
p_ols    <- ols_ct["x","Pr(>|t|)"]

# 3) First stage: x on z (+ controls)
fs <- lm(form_fs, data = df)
fs_ct <- coeftest(fs, vcov. = vcovHC(fs, type = "HC1"))
# Extract the instrument's coefficient row name (assumes 'z' is named 'z')
if(!"z" %in% rownames(fs_ct)) stop("Instrument 'z' not found in first stage.")
beta_fs <- fs_ct["z","Estimate"]
se_fs   <- fs_ct["z","Std. Error"]
t_fs    <- fs_ct["z","t value"]
F_fs    <- as.numeric(t_fs^2)

# Partial R^2 of z in first stage (conditional on controls)
if (has_controls) {
  fs_restricted <- lm(as.formula(paste("x ~", paste(controls, collapse = " + "))), data = df)
  R2_full <- summary(fs)$r.squared
  R2_rest <- summary(fs_restricted)$r.squared
  partial_R2 <- (R2_full - R2_rest) / (1 - R2_rest)
} else {
  # With only z, partial R^2 equals R^2
  partial_R2 <- summary(fs)$r.squared
}

# 4) Reduced form: y on z (+ controls)
rf <- lm(form_rf, data = df)
rf_ct <- coeftest(rf, vcov. = vcovHC(rf, type = "HC1"))
beta_rf <- rf_ct["z","Estimate"]
se_rf   <- rf_ct["z","Std. Error"]
p_rf    <- rf_ct["z","Pr(>|t|)"]

# 5) 2SLS using the lottery as instrument for x
iv <- ivreg(form_iv, data = df)
iv_vcov <- vcovHC(iv, type = "HC1")
iv_ct <- coeftest(iv, vcov. = iv_vcov)
beta_iv <- iv_ct["x","Estimate"]
se_iv   <- iv_ct["x","Std. Error"]
p_iv    <- iv_ct["x","Pr(>|t|)"]
ci_low  <- beta_iv + qnorm(0.025) * se_iv
ci_high <- beta_iv + qnorm(0.975) * se_iv

# 6) Endogeneity test (Durbin-Wu-Hausman via residual inclusion, robust SE)
v_hat <- resid(fs)
df$v_hat <- v_hat
form_dwh <- as.formula(
  if (has_controls) paste("y ~ x +", paste(controls, collapse = " + "), "+ v_hat")
  else "y ~ x + v_hat"
)
dwh_mod <- lm(form_dwh, data = df)
dwh_ct <- coeftest(dwh_mod, vcov. = vcovHC(dwh_mod, type = "HC1"))
# p-value for residual term
p_dwh <- dwh_ct["v_hat","Pr(>|t|)"]

# 7) Robustness: IV without controls (specification check)
iv_noc <- ivreg(y ~ x | z, data = df)
iv_noc_ct <- coeftest(iv_noc, vcov. = vcovHC(iv_noc, type = "HC1"))
beta_iv_noc <- iv_noc_ct["x","Estimate"]
se_iv_noc   <- iv_noc_ct["x","Std. Error"]
p_iv_noc    <- iv_noc_ct["x","Pr(>|t|)"]

# 8) Print a clear, concise summary of numerical results
cat("=== First Stage (x on z [+ controls]) ===\n")
cat(sprintf("Coeff on z: % .4f (SE robust: %.4f), t=%.2f, F (robust, 1 df) = %.2f\n",
            beta_fs, se_fs, t_fs, F_fs))
cat(sprintf("Partial R^2 of instrument (conditional): %.4f\n\n", partial_R2))

cat("=== Reduced Form (y on z [+ controls]) ===\n")
cat(sprintf("ITT (z -> y): % .4f (SE robust: %.4f), p=%.3f\n\n", beta_rf, se_rf, p_rf))

cat("=== OLS (y on x [+ controls]) ===\n")
cat(sprintf("Beta_x (OLS): % .4f (SE robust: %.4f), p=%.3f\n\n", beta_ols, se_ols, p_ols))

cat("=== 2SLS IV (y on x; instrument = z [+ controls]) ===\n")
cat(sprintf("Beta_x (IV): % .4f (SE robust: %.4f), p=%.3f\n", beta_iv, se_iv, p_iv))
cat(sprintf("95%% CI (robust): [% .4f, % .4f]\n\n", ci_low, ci_high))

# Load data, run sharp RDD with local linear (triangular kernel), and report estimates
# Robustness: polynomial order, bandwidths, kernels, placebo cutoff, and (optionally) rdrobust if available.

# 1) Read data
df <- read.csv("experiments/exp_b/data/s26_data.csv")

# 2) Helper: Local linear sharp RDD
rdd_fit <- function(data, cutoff = 0.5, h = 0.3, poly = 1, kernel = "triangular") {
  # Center running variable
  x_all <- data$running_var - cutoff
  in_bw <- abs(x_all) <= h
  x <- x_all[in_bw]
  y <- data$y[in_bw]
  treated <- as.numeric(data$running_var[in_bw] >= cutoff)
  
  # Build design
  dat <- data.frame(y = y, treated = treated, x = x)
  if (poly >= 2) dat$x2 <- x^2
  
  # Weights
  if (kernel == "triangular") {
    w <- pmax(0, 1 - abs(x) / h)
  } else {
    # uniform kernel as default alternative
    w <- rep(1, length(x))
  }
  
  # Formula: different slopes on each side + jump at cutoff (treated)
  if (poly == 1) {
    form <- y ~ treated + x + treated:x
  } else {
    form <- y ~ treated + x + treated:x + x2 + treated:x2
  }
  
  fit <- lm(form, data = dat, weights = w)
  
  # Robust (HC1) standard errors if available
  use_robust <- requireNamespace("sandwich", quietly = TRUE) && requireNamespace("lmtest", quietly = TRUE)
  if (use_robust) {
    vc <- sandwich::vcovHC(fit, type = "HC1")
    ct <- lmtest::coeftest(fit, vcov. = vc)
    if (!("treated" %in% rownames(ct))) {
      stop("Coefficient 'treated' not found. Check model specification.")
    }
    est <- ct["treated", 1]; se <- ct["treated", 2]; tval <- ct["treated", 3]; pval <- ct["treated", 4]
  } else {
    sm <- summary(fit)
    rn <- rownames(sm$coefficients)
    idx <- which(rn == "treated")
    if (length(idx) != 1) stop("Coefficient 'treated' not found. Check model specification.")
    est <- sm$coefficients[idx, 1]; se <- sm$coefficients[idx, 2]; tval <- sm$coefficients[idx, 3]; pval <- sm$coefficients[idx, 4]
  }
  ci_low <- est - 1.96 * se
  ci_high <- est + 1.96 * se
  
  list(est = est, se = se, t = tval, p = pval, ci = c(ci_low, ci_high),
       n = length(y), h = h, poly = poly, kernel = kernel)
}

# 3) Main specification: local linear, triangular kernel, bandwidth h = 0.3 (matches near_cutoff definition)
main <- rdd_fit(df, cutoff = 0.5, h = 0.3, poly = 1, kernel = "triangular")
cat("MAIN RDD (c=0.5, h=0.3, local linear, triangular):\n")
cat(sprintf("  N (within h): %d\n  Jump (treated): %.4f\n  SE: %.4f\n  95%% CI: [%.4f, %.4f]\n  p-value: %.4g\n\n",
            main$n, main$est, main$se, main$ci[1], main$ci[2], main$p))

# 4) Robustness: polynomial order (quadratic), bandwidth sensitivity, kernel sensitivity
# 4a) Quadratic
quad <- rdd_fit(df, cutoff = 0.5, h = 0.3, poly = 2, kernel = "triangular")
cat("ROBUSTNESS - Quadratic (c=0.5, h=0.3, triangular):\n")
cat(sprintf("  Jump: %.4f  SE: %.4f  95%% CI: [%.4f, %.4f]  p-value: %.4g\n\n",
            quad$est, quad$se, quad$ci[1], quad$ci[2], quad$p))

# 4b) Bandwidth sensitivity (triangular)
for (h in c(0.20, 0.25, 0.30)) {
  fit_h <- rdd_fit(df, cutoff = 0.5, h = h, poly = 1, kernel = "triangular")
  cat(sprintf("ROBUSTNESS - Bandwidth h=%.2f (triangular):  Jump=%.4f  SE=%.4f  95%% CI=[%.4f, %.4f]  p=%.4g  N=%d\n",
              h, fit_h$est, fit_h$se, fit_h$ci[1], fit_h$ci[2], fit_h$p, fit_h$n))
}
cat("\n")

# 4c) Kernel sensitivity (uniform, h=0.3)
uniform_fit <- rdd_fit(df, cutoff = 0.5, h = 0.3, poly = 1, kernel = "uniform")
cat("ROBUSTNESS - Kernel (uniform, h=0.3):\n")
cat(sprintf("  Jump: %.4f  SE: %.4f  95%% CI: [%.4f, %.4f]  p-value: %.4g  N=%d\n\n",
            uniform_fit$est, uniform_fit$se, uniform_fit$ci[1], uniform_fit$ci[2], uniform_fit$p, uniform_fit$n))

# 5) Placebo cutoff at 0.6 (within support)
placebo <- rdd_fit(df, cutoff = 0.6, h = 0.3, poly = 1, kernel = "triangular")
cat("PLACEBO RDD (c=0.6, h=0.3, local linear, triangular):\n")
cat(sprintf("  Jump: %.4f  SE: %.4f  95%% CI: [%.4f, %.4f]  p-value: %.4g  N=%d\n\n",
            placebo$est, placebo$se, placebo$ci[1], placebo$ci[2], placebo$p, placebo$n))

# 6) Optional: Data-driven bandwidth with rdrobust (if installed)
if (requireNamespace("rdrobust", quietly = TRUE)) {
  cat("RDROBUST (data-driven bandwidths, triangular, p=1):\n")
  rd <- rdrobust::rdrobust(y = df$y, x = df$running_var, c = 0.5, p = 1, kernel = "triangular")
  print(rd)
  cat("\n")
} else {
  cat("Note: Package 'rdrobust' not installed; skipped data-driven bandwidth estimation.\n")
}

local_linear_rd <- function(y, x, c=0, h=0.1, p=1, kernel="triangular") {

  if (kernel == "triangular") {
    w <- pmax(0, 1 - abs(x_c)/h)
  } else if (kernel == "uniform") {
    w <- as.numeric(abs(x_c) <= h)
  } else {
    stop("Unsupported kernel.")
  }

dr_test <- function(data, w) {

                order = order, donut = donut))
  }
  ys <- y[idx]; Ds <- D[idx]; ss <- s[idx]
  # Weights

    w <- pmax(0, 1 - abs(ss)/h)

cat("Max running_var among treated:", max_treated, "\n")

cutoff <- (max_treated + min_untreated) / 2

# Treatment should be: treated = 1 if running_var < cutoff
sharp_check <- all(df$treated == as.integer(df$running_var < cutoff))
cat("Sharp RDD confirmed:", sharp_check, "\n")

# If not perfectly sharp, try different cutoff values
if (!sharp_check) {
  # Try common cutoffs
  for (c in c(0.5, 0.45, 0.4, 0.3)) {
    check <- mean(df$treated == as.integer(df$running_var < c))
    cat("Cutoff =", c, "-> agreement:", check, "\n")
    if (check > 0.99) { cutoff <- c; break }
  }
}

# Center the running variable at the cutoff
df$X <- df$running_var - cutoff

cat("\n=== Distribution Around Cutoff ===\n")
cat("N treated:", sum(df$treated), "\n")
cat("N control:", sum(df$treated == 0), "\n")
cat("N near cutoff:", sum(df$near_cutoff), "\n")

# ========================================

# ========================================

rd_msetwo <- rdrobust(y = df$y, x = df$X, c = 0, bwselect = "msetwo")
